L59: ### Melanoma Treatment Study
L60: 
L61: Now Enrolling Patients​
L62: 
L63: #### Study Overview
L64: 
L65: The primary objective of this study is to confirm that Gilvetmab is safe and effective in dogs diagnosed with malignant melanoma.
L66: 
L67: #### Eligibility Criteria:
L68: 
L69: For full inclusion criteria, reach out to the participating hospital directly.
L70: 
L71:   * Dog is ≥ 1 year of age
L72:   * Dog is ≥ 6.6lbs
L73:   * Dogs diagnosed with malignant melanoma
L74: 
L75: #### Study Timeline
L76: 
L77:   * 190 days
L78:   * 14 clinic visits over study duration
L79: ### Interested in this study?
L80: Reach out to a participating hospital to learn more!
L81: 
L82: #### Ethos Hospitals
L83: 
L84: Metropolitan Veterinary Hospital: Cleveland, OH
L85: 
L86: Summit Veterinary Referral Center: Tacoma, WA
L87: 
L88: Veterinary Specialty Hospital: San Diego, CA
L89: 
L90: ##### Benefits to Participation
L91: 
L92: All study related visits are covered at no cost to the pet parent.
